prompt:

Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design-friendly secure auth form, compact, calm, no marketing hero.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian #09090b for primary CTA; gray helper text; no colorful security gradient.
